newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 389 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 389 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 389 contracts compared with 451 overnight Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 36 wheat, 120 corn, 146 soybean, four soymeal, 12 soyoil, two oat, 34 corn call, 30 corn put and five soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was unchanged to 3/4 cent lower, corn was steady to 1/4 lower and soybeans were 1/4 to 3/4 cent lower.
